entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal memory layer with multi-level support for user, session, and agent states. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available through a managed cloud, an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server, or an OSS SDK.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an official AGPL-3.0 context database that organizes agent memory as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading strategy (Abstract, Overview, Details) to achieve significant token reduction and improved task-completion rates.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This open-source platform provides agents with persistent long-term memory through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It distills session lessons into durable memory and supports local extraction and embedding models without requiring LLM API keys.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes provider, this engine features a custom vector graph engine capable of sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It maintains auto-updated user profiles and supports multi-modal extraction from sources including PDFs, images, and code.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain stores explicit facts with provenance and shared access across multiple agents. It utilizes a synthesis layer for cited answers and gap analysis, supported by keyword retrieval, semantic search, and a typed knowledge graph.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows for agent memory across Python, Node.js, and Go environments. It supports over 25 LLM providers and achieved state-of-the-art performance on the LongMemEval benchmark.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This FastAPI-based library serves as the core service for building stateful agents and acts as the upstream for the Hermes self-hosted wrapper. It provides Python and TypeScript SDKs with support for managed, local, and self-hosted deployment options.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official provider manages memory as a git-like repository, offering version control features like commit, branch, and merge for markdown context trees. It employs a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based, achieving sub-100ms performance.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that uses a single SQLite database for local storage. It features episodic compression for sub-linear storage growth and integrates via MCP, Python SDK, or OpenWebUI.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This system utilizes a seven-layer memory architecture including vector search on Qdrant and an auto-curated wiki. It relies on a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context within a local infrastructure of Docker, Redis, and SQLite.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness designed to help agents succeed on complex tasks through filesystem-first artifacts like playbooks and context bundles. It supports Python and TypeScript surfaces and integrates with MCP clients and self-hosted endpoints.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This Lossless Context Management plugin uses a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost during agent operations. It provides specialized recall tools such as lcm_grep and lcm_recall for precise detail recovery in Python 3.11+ environments.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes local session history from 34 different coding agents to enable millisecond lookups over gigabytes of historical data. It allows users to search months of past sessions while automatically stripping keys and tokens during the indexing process.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend provides private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent using an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports persistence across any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference server.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur offers a shared memory layer that stores data as plain-text YAML engrams on a local disk for multi-agent tool portability. It utilizes a hybrid retrieval system combining BM25 and local embeddings, accessible via MCP server integration.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI is a local-first identity and memory layer that syncs state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and other harnesses with 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy. It supports real-time ingestion from external sources including Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates entirely locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It employs hybrid retrieval through BM25 and vector search, integrating with agents via MCP and specialized hooks.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a durable, file-based system that uses a five-tier hierarchical SQLite schema instead of vector databases or embedding models. It provides a five-package plugin family, including a dedicated Hermes adapter and CLI, for cross-platform use.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This project optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to reduce prefill latency by 1.5–3×. It offers native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem to save up to 36% in token usage while preserving accuracy.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin features explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every result. It includes primitives for contradiction tracking and a self-directing loop to identify and queue knowledge gaps.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata. It leverages a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and integrates with coding agents via MCP servers.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This CLI maintains agent-driven wikis with citations and provenance, allowing agents to autonomously evolve knowledge across sessions. It uses SQLite for storage and supports portable archives for merging wiki data between environments.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd implements an anticipatory cache that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It is a local-first system using SQLite-vec and GGUF models, delivered as an MCP-native server.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack is a memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner for Hermes Agent. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide purpose-built evidence packets per query.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This context layer resolves live workspace states into verified facts to ensure agents only load necessary data. It features local-first session tracking and supports MCP-native integration via stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system utilizes BM25 full-text search and ranked graph traversal for information retrieval. It automates indexing for codebases and multimedia using OCR and edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed for Hermes Agent v0.14.0, this tool reduces prompt token overhead through local BM25 tool ranking. It includes a dedicated dashboard to track estimated schema token savings and supports native tool search.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed workflow layer manages context updates for coding agents using hash-checked proposals and receipts. It provides a source-neutral migration path for chat and document exports across multiple supported agent platforms.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a single .lbdb embedded graph database to store and rank memories by importance. It combines BM25 keyword search with optional GLiNER2 entity extraction to surface high-priority entries during context prefetch.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features a pull-model that supports immediate event deletion and an on-demand summarizer. It maintains a trace.jsonl audit log to provide a transparent record of every memory and prefetch operation.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to manage budget-bound wallets and process x402 payments across multiple blockchain families. The system operates without a backend, database, or API keys, facilitating direct stablecoin transactions.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local scripts, runbooks, and MCP configurations to facilitate capability routing. It provides tools for neighbor traversal and knowledge search, supporting automatic tool-OKF generation via detached model calls.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables cross-agent continuity by allowing agents to read memories from other connected sessions. It utilizes native lifecycle hooks for snapshots and a local SQLite layer to ensure write outbox reliability.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It includes tools for manual memory storage and supports configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories through a required local SourceVault server. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for semantic search, file reads, and grounded Q&A.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This memory solution offers AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon, featuring MinHash deduplication and metadata filters.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search approach that combines BM25, vector, and graph methods. It supports automatic context checkpointing during message compression to maintain continuity.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This tool focuses on memory hygiene through a git-backed directory of markdown files, allowing for versioned and diffable memory without a database. It utilizes five slash commands and specialized curators to identify stale data or contradictions, proposing evidence-cited updates for review.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework automates specification elicitation and implementation planning while adhering to TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles. It integrates with multiple coding harnesses and CLI tools to provide a structured software development methodology for agents.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system that enables Hermes Agent to generate web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts via a dedicated CLI. It supports native agent runtimes through the DeepSeek Harness and exports designs into formats including HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and ATLAS. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms, offering a comprehensive security layer for agentic operations.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill allows agents to convert codebases, infrastructure-as-code, and schemas into draw.io diagrams using natural language. It supports incremental synchronization to preserve manual layouts and is available as a CLI or MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this project facilitates natural-language mandates, ERC-7710 delegated permissions, and x402 payments. It includes a master router and connector skills to manage verification, escrow, and dispute resolution.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a two-pass editing process and optional voice profiles. It functions in rewrite, detect-only, and edit-in-place modes for Hermes and Claude Code users.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project automates skill deduplication and cross-pollination across isolated agent silos to facilitate collective skill evolution. It features a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and integrates with Hermes, Codex, and Claude Code.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state within the project's documentation folder to support Claude Code and other compatible agents.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,170 markdown-based skills for professional and personal tasks that run natively in Hermes Agent without requiring accounts or telemetry. It provides ready-to-paste exports for assistants including Claude, Gemini, and Cursor.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables Hermes Agent to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlists from YouTube. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with OpenClaw, Claude Code, and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage detected patterns via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI, enabling remote skill registries via Git and S3. It features sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host while offering tools to read bundled resources.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by generating documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically syncs edits back to the original literate documentation.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: Designed to convert rough concepts into structured design and implementation documents, this workflow includes both Lite and Full modes for varying project scales. It ensures quality through a spec review gate utilizing PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Running on Bun without background services, this harness implements the SLP v2 protocol for supervised cooperative-agent teams. It manages work, decisions, and evidence through a CLI-driven mechanism kernel to support long-running agents.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models based on recorded work.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource offers agentskills.io-compatible skills and guides for VPS production, backups, and cron automation in Portuguese. It facilitates integrations with messaging platforms including Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Following the Agent Skills specification, this toolkit enables interactions with oracle networks and smart contracts. It supports CCIP, VRF, Data Feeds, and Data Streams, and is installable via the Vercel CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills provide API integration for FLUX image and video generation, including support for polling and webhooks. The suite features eight specialist skills specifically for the FLUX 3 video suite and prompting guidelines.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It features automated workflows for briefing, testing, and exporting skills while linking instructions to specific file lines.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language for AI that operates through a single Rust binary and four core verbs: infer, invoke, exec, and agent. It maintains local traces and verification journals for every execution run.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry for reusable AI skills includes a Python client and CLI that supports installation with recursive dependency resolution. It also incorporates commerce features powered by TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Focused on complex multi-step tasks, this skill provides autonomous execution with real-time tracking of decisions and progress. It ensures reliability through built-in rollback procedures and checkpoints for safe recovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts using WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication over HTTPS via Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search integration across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project provides a five-layer intelligent retrieval system that uses hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists. By filtering skills before LLM calls, it reduces token usage and offers graceful degradation if specific dependencies are missing.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project facilitates agent-driven scheduling and habit tracking via an MCP connection. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and includes both a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This skill performs adversarial code reviews by deploying three parallel subagents to identify edge cases and integration issues. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes and scores prompts across multiple interfaces, including CLI, Discord, and Telegram, to reduce token usage by 20–80%. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a multi-agent swarm to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. It features a tiered application process that requires an approval gate before applying simplified changes.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements systematic investigation protocols and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python goal engine for persistent state management to prevent early-stop errors during complex debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and provides automatic registration for common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey laboratory equips Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to address CVE-driven scenarios ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This suite adds session management and worktree recovery tools to provide memory and state drift detection between agent conversations. It also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and provides scaffolding for new skill development.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent across 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs, session history, and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry and can optionally send incident alerts to Telegram or Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible recording scripts and optimized GIFs for repository READMEs using vhs or Playwright. It manages the entire pipeline from rendering and compression to embedding the final markdown, targeting file sizes under 8 MB.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool enables users to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills directly from the terminal or an AI agent. It provides direct installation commands for discovered plugins and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates Claude Code and portable Agent Skills from plain language while monitoring official frontmatter specs weekly to detect drift. It uses CI-friendly exit codes to validate skills against runtime-specific profiles, ensuring they remain functional and spec-compliant.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify and propose skill coverage gaps. It operates locally using the Python standard library and gates all skill updates behind deterministic, LLM-judge, and regression evaluators.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized tools for transcribing Douyin videos into Markdown, extracting structured data via macOS Vision OCR, and removing common Chinese AI writing patterns. It is designed for content creation tasks, including e-commerce material generation and SRT subtitle production.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These skills enable Hermes Agent to handle deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, and WSL environments. The tool ensures file operations use environment-specific syntax and verifies project-compatible runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.superagnt/leverage: This project offers a suite of skills for social data scraping, lead enrichment, and SEO automation compatible with agentskills.io clients. It includes integrated support for MCP servers and provides agents with persistent resources like workspace Postgres databases and shareable dashboards.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols. It is built to be compatible with the OpenClaw and Hermes Agent ecosystems following the agentskills.io standard.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project provides a functional quality seal by testing agent skills for structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures and offers a public API for verification and submission.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows Hermes Agent users to earn or distribute USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties over the x402 protocol. It operates without accounts or API keys, utilizing a dedicated wallet key and user-defined price ceilings for automated payouts.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project exposes 191 tools via a hosted MCP server to provide structured web data across 31 different platforms. It includes five production-grade workflow skills and supports integration with Claude, Cursor, Goose, and OpenHands.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill enables Hermes Agent to generate multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search results with user interests and produces structured briefs that include core conclusions and actionable suggestions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes and tools from major providers like OpenAI and Google. It serves as a specialized distribution layer for users who require reproducible development environments and automated package maintenance.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI interaction by leveraging Termux:API and Termux:GUI for mobile agent operations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a Termux-based automated installation script that utilizes proot-distro Ubuntu to run Hermes Agent on Android. The setup supports shell command execution and interactive model configuration through both external providers and local Ollama instances.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates the deployment of Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on cloud-native state safety. It enforces single-writer access for persistent storage and supports both direct deployments and operator-ready CRD workflows.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android and iOS, this project brings Hermes to mobile platforms via Termux and iSH. It distinguishes itself by integrating with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supporting scheduled tasks through cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw focuses on high-security deployments by implementing hardware-enforced sandboxing via NVIDIA OpenShell. It provides kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access, allowing for granular security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane designed to deploy and monitor Hermes agents across Docker and Kubernetes environments. It features a 69-entry credential catalog, support for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a straightforward Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables declarative configuration of Hermes Agent deployments, including workspace documents and CLI settings. It offers a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure handling of secrets via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ acts as a Docker-first control plane for managing multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. The platform supports inter-agent delegation with hierarchy-aware communication and enterprise MCP access for external clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting production environments on Ubuntu and Debian, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for headless operation, enabling the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and Nous Portal integration.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from external drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework organizes specialized agents into a multi-tier structure of researchers, traders, and portfolio managers for financial analysis. It enables backtesting across various LLM providers and data vendors to evaluate fundamental, sentiment, and technical trading strategies.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, and cost tracking through a centralized Web UI or CLI. It supports multi-agent workflows with integrated memory browsing and can be deployed locally via Node.js or Docker.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent, using tmux for persistent background execution and Docker for sandboxed environments. Users can monitor agent activity and review code diffs through both TUI and web-based dashboards.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This execution engine is the first to manage Hermes agents on the Solana blockchain while supporting the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode. It features specialized detection for HTTP signals to handle payment-required states for paid API services.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this template scales Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills for infrastructure tasks such as security auditing, VPS provisioning, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework facilitates the creation of autonomous agent swarms with durable memory and support for over 23 LLM providers. It features visual org charts to manage agent team delegation and integrates with MCP tools for expanded capabilities.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface provides a Kanban board and live streaming of agent reasoning to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent tasks. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification, requiring manual approval for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system employs a strict pipeline architecture to coordinate 17 specialized agents across research, planning, and infrastructure domains. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of these agents to ensure structured task execution.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using Hermes Agent profiles and a real-time Web UI. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols to handle local tools and communication throughout the automated task lifecycle.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark code for Hermes Agent, referencing Arxiv research for its methodology. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while tracking candidate mutations and frontier progress.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to track performance metrics and GitHub star growth. It utilizes Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard to visualize code and scoreboard data.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: Optimized for consumer GPUs, this fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling. It eliminates cloud dependencies by running parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool utilizes a Rust-powered kernel to maintain a 100% local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph that auto-syncs on every file change. It integrates with Hermes Agent via an MCP server to minimize token usage and tool calls by providing efficient access to codebase data.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This CLI utility monitors token usage and associated costs across various AI coding agents including Hermes and Claude Code. It features a TUI and a 3D visualization dashboard, allowing users to submit their data to a public leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while automatically redacting authentication headers. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions to facilitate detailed debugging of agent interactions.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of token consumption, costs, and rate limits for over 38 tools by reading Hermes Agent state directly. It supports real-time synchronization across multiple machines and offers historical breakdowns by session and model.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It is compatible with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot, supporting any provider that utilizes markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents, such as a CTO and Builder, to manage the full application lifecycle. It includes 36 skills for deployment and monitoring, operating autonomously while requiring human approval for irreversible actions.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This community-driven project provides custom themes and CLI skins for the Hermes terminal interface. Users can configure YAML files to modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art, with options ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk aesthetics.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This social economy platform enables autonomous agents to communicate via encrypted Signal Protocol messaging and register human-readable handles. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce by supporting Solana-based payments in USDC and SOL.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 native skills directly into the Claude Code Channel without requiring OAuth or external processes. It specifically includes MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: This AI-native browser is designed for autonomous agent control, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing approvals and conversation checkpoints. It supports external MCP clients and provides built-in integration for providers like Anthropic, OpenAI, and Ollama.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It extends these capabilities to chat platforms including Telegram, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for research and DevOps, featuring an automated installer for macOS and Linux.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This tool provides deterministic static analysis for AI agent configurations and system prompts without requiring LLM calls. It identifies ambiguous tools and contract mismatches across Markdown, JSON, and YAML formats using HERM v1.1 scoring.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a framework for creating scoped Hermes Agents that utilize per-folder configurations and project-local memories. It allows users to switch between default and scoped agents while maintaining localized skills and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This automated installer deploys a full hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable tiers. It includes support for 29 community plugins, enabling a production-ready environment with zero cost using free models.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw environments to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON. It also automates the setup of systemd gateway services and handles nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco offers self-healing observability for multi-agent systems through a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry. It features zero-token passive analysis and active probing to detect performance drift relative to local configuration changes.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: This project provides a deterministic local runtime designed to help users generate revenue using Hermes Agent. It enforces a security model requiring explicit approval for all external writes and consequential actions through specific contract types.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This plugin adds offline, voice-enabled assistant capabilities to Hermes Agent with support for 35 languages and wake-word activation. It features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in functionality without requiring API keys or external accounts.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin integrates MemOS with Hermes to provide semantic search and multi-dimensional storage capabilities. It includes tools for managing memories and a circuit breaker to handle potential API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It serves as an all-in-one interface for managing configurations across multiple agentic tools and CLI interfaces, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local open-source cowork application that enables autonomous multi-step tasks with user approval and file access. It supports both built-in and external agents like Hermes Agent and provides remote access through a WebUI and messaging platforms like Telegram.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: This interface runs the Hermes agent in-process to maintain 1:1 feature parity with the CLI without requiring an external API server. It utilizes a three-panel layout to organize sessions, chat, and file browsing for web and mobile users.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the initial experience with guided installation and provider setup for Hermes Agent. It provides a graphical interface for managing sessions, tools, and chat across multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard offers unified configuration for ten communication platforms and supports runtimes including Hermes and Claude Code. It features a visual workflow builder with cron-based scheduling, approval gates, and usage analytics.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser and PTY terminal alongside specialized tools for memory browsing and MCP catalog management.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative coding workspace that aggregates sessions from fifteen built-in agents and supports custom ACP-compatible agent registration. It can be deployed as a desktop app, Docker container, or standalone server with native iOS and Android clients for remote access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It includes an embedded terminal for system repair and native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes a built-in kernel with health check and update capabilities. The UI supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering while providing dedicated management for chat and memory.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects the active browser context to local, cloud, or remote Hermes Agent runtimes. It allows users to switch between multi-agent profiles and use AI-assisted tab scoping to control prompt context.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app that pairs with a hermes-webui server to drive a self-hosted agent from a mobile device. It supports real-time chat streaming with tool-call details and provides mobile management for skills and scheduled tasks.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for engines like Hermes Agent and Claude Code while providing custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking token usage and a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI consciousness monitor features nine tabs and four color themes for tracking agent growth and git projects. It includes a tmux operator view designed for managing live agent panes and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It features a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time chat with tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that allows users to search prompts, tool calls, and command outputs across local agent histories. It tracks per-session token burn and estimated costs using a locally built search index that avoids uploading telemetry.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for communication.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: This OpenTUI-based dashboard provides a terminal interface for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It supports the management of profiles, skills, and toolsets, and includes a kanban board for agentic task management.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA for Telegram that supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs via contained Python and Node.js environments without requiring admin rights or Docker. It includes 100 tools for TTS, music, and ComfyUI, supported by a built-in workflow engine for multi-step pipelines.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, MCP servers, and an integrated file browser.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A monitoring dashboard that provides real-time tracking of session activity and API costs. It allows for the full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, alongside read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This chat-first workspace features real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for runtime control. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A native desktop client that orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports model switching with streaming SSE responses.
